commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: - **Deliberately did NOT delete the 10 old `*-page.ts` mount scripts** (unlike the plan's literal Phase 6 description) — the still-live Vite pipeline's `algorithms/<id>/explainer/index.html` shells reference them directly via `<script src="/src/explainers/<id>-page.ts">`; deleting them now would be a real **build failure** for `npm run build:check` (Vite can't resolve the script src), not just a runtime degradation like the Phase 3 `main.ts` edit. Consistent with the Phase 1/3 deferral pattern: old mount scripts + HTML shells get deleted together at Phase 9/10 cutover, keeping the still-live pipeline buildable until then.
- `npx astro check` (0 errors), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests), `npm run build:check` (still-live Vite pipeline, completely unmodified this phase) all pass.

- Next: Phase 7 (nav/SEO parity + RSS) — diff `@astrojs/sitemap` output against full expected coverage (now including the 10 explainer pages), add `src/pages/rss.xml.js` for the blog, spot-check OG/canonical tags per page type, replace the placeholder blog post if desired.
- **Phase 7 (nav/SEO parity + RSS) — done, plus filled a real gap in the plan.**

- **Gap found**: the approved plan's phase table never actually assigned a phase to building the real blog routes (`/blog/` listing + `/blog/[slug]/` detail) — Phase 2 only called for a placeholder post to prove the `blog` collection resolves. Since shipping a working blog was the user's original motivation for this entire migration, building those routes was folded into this phase rather than left undone.

- Built `src/pages/blog/index.astro` (lists non-draft posts sorted by `pubDate` desc, empty state when zero posts) and `src/pages/blog/[slug]/index.astro` (`getStaticPaths()` over `getCollection('blog', ({data}) => !data.draft)`, `render(post)` for the body). Both filter out `draft: true` posts, so the placeholder `welcome.md` (still `draft: true`) correctly does not generate a `/blog/welcome/` page or appear in the listing — confirms the draft-filtering mechanism works, at the cost of an empty blog for now (expected, real content is a future task).

- Added `src/pages/rss.xml.js` using `@astrojs/rss` (installed back in Phase 1), same draft filter, `context.site` from `astro.config.mjs`. Zero `<item>` entries currently (no published posts) — valid RSS structure either way.

- Added a "Blog" link to `Topbar.astro` (between the Algorithms dropdown and GitHub link) — without it there'd be no discovery path to `/blog/` at all except a direct URL. `Topbar.astro` is Astro-only (the still-live Vite pipeline uses `nav-html.mjs`'s `renderTopbarHtml()` directly, a completely separate code path), so this edit carries zero risk to the old pipeline.
- Sitemap coverage verified complete: 33 URLs (18 docs + 10 explainers + 4 static pages + `/blog/`), zero duplicates, `/rss.xml` correctly excluded (not an HTML page).

- OG/canonical spot-checked across page types: blog index gets `og:type=website` (default), blog posts get `og:type=article` (explicit), explainer pages get `og:type=article` — and now correctly have canonical/OG tags at all, which the **old hand-authored explainer shells never had** (a genuine, disclosed SEO improvement, not scope creep — falls directly out of routing every page through the same `BaseLayout`).
- Verified via Playwright + screenshot: `/blog/` renders correctly with the topbar Blog link present and the empty-state message, zero console errors.

- `npx astro check` (0 errors), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests), `npm run build:check` (still-live Vite pipeline, unaffected — `Topbar.astro` isn't in its dependency graph) all pass.

- Next: Phase 8 (testing) — update `vitest.config.ts`/`playwright.config.ts` for Astro's dev server (default port 4321 vs Vite's 5173), run the full Playwright suite (`tests/webmcp.spec.ts`) against the Astro build, manual Lighthouse/CLS check on the homepage.

commit.message:
Log Phase 7 (nav/SEO parity + RSS) completion for Astro migration

Filled a real gap in the approved plan: no phase had actually been
assigned to building the real /blog/ + /blog/[slug]/ routes, even
though shipping a working blog was the original motivation for this
migration. Built both routes with draft filtering, RSS feed, and a
topbar Blog link. Sitemap coverage verified complete (33 URLs, zero
duplicates). Explainer pages now have OG/canonical tags they never
had before — a genuine improvement, not scope creep.

Implements [[tasks/teeline-web-astro7-migration]]
